note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-24): 11 pictures from 22 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God is not pictured. Genesis 10 is a list of the peoples, so the pictures show what the list means (one family spreading into many nations, lands and families) through the lands themselves: three brothers walking together after the rain (v1, ordinary men of today), islands each with its own harbor town (the coastland nations), the great river (Egypt and Cush), a lone hunter seen against the sky (Nimrod, an ordinary hunter of today), a great city on a plain, families each at their own door, dandelion seeds crossing a boundary wall (scattered, the border), a long family table (Shem and Eber), a river dividing a plain (Peleg, the earth divided), the dry hill country of the east, and the lights of towns scattered over the dark earth. No tower (Genesis 11) and no rainbow (Genesis 9). Second picture of each pair kept out: an oak with three boughs, a market hall of many peoples, construction cranes, a savanna river, a boulder hunter with a dog, a wall between green and dry land, a family group from above (it ran lower than the word box allows), a valley river, sheep facing the dawn and villages at first light.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: After the flood the whole human family begins again from Noah's three sons: one family, three branches.
ideas: One old tree whose trunk divides into three great boughs under a clear morning sky
Three brothers seen from behind walking side by side on a wet road across a fresh green plain
Three young saplings growing from one rain-soaked field
A family tree growing out of one root, three thick limbs
Three rivers leaving one lake
A tray of three seed packets spilled on a table
Three paths leaving one doorstep into green country
A father's hand on three sons' shoulders
Three candles lit from one flame
One loaf broken in three pieces

sections.meaning: Japheth's sons spread out to the coastlands, and the coastland nations separated, each in its own land, with its own language and family.
ideas: Sailboats setting out from a harbor at sunrise toward far islands and coasts
Aerial view of an archipelago, each island with its own small harbor town and bay
A rocky headland with one lighthouse-less bay and a single boat
A shoreline with many different small villages along it
Waves washing a map-less coast of separate coves
A ferry crossing between two islands
A ship's wake across a calm sea at dawn
A fisherman's net drying on a quay
A chain of green islands in mist
Three boats leaving one bay in three directions

sections.meaning: Ham's sons Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan, and the sons of Cush: peoples of the great river and the lands to the south.
ideas: A broad slow river through desert at dawn with palms, reeds and one white-sailed boat
Green southern savanna with acacia trees and a river at sunrise
A strip of green farmland along a river cutting through pale desert
Reed beds along a wide river at dusk
A date palm grove at the edge of the sand
Dunes meeting a green river bank
A heron on a river sandbar at dawn
A flood-plain field under a huge sky
A river bend seen from a high cliff
A herd of cattle drinking at a river

sections.meaning: Nimrod was the first mighty man on earth, a mighty hunter before Yahweh, and his kingdom began with cities in Shinar and he built a great city.
ideas: Seen from behind, a lone hunter with a bow on a high ridge at dawn over a vast golden plain, a hound at his side
A powerful hunter silhouetted on a boulder against a huge open sky, bow in hand
Aerial view at dusk of a great city sprawling across a wide plain beside a river, lit streets and bridges
A city under construction at sunrise with cranes and half-built blocks over a broad river plain
A hunter's weathered hand drawing a bow string
Bow and quiver resting on a rock at sunrise
A walled city on a hill at dawn
A new road leading into a great plain of cities
A river with four cities along it seen at night
A crown of lights over a wide plain

sections.meaning: From Egypt and Canaan came many peoples and families, who were scattered over the land within a border that ran from Sidon to Gaza and to Sodom.
ideas: A busy covered market hall where people of many backgrounds talk and trade in small circles
Many differently painted front doors in a row down a narrow hill street, a family on each doorstep
A dandelion gone to seed, its seeds streaming away in the wind over an old stone boundary wall on a green hill above the sea
A thin old stone wall running over green hills from a harbor toward dry country, a border between green and dry land
A seaside bazaar with groups in different dress talking with their hands
A crossroads of four roads with travelers
A busy quay with sailors from many ships
A railway station crowd of travelers
A beach of coastal dunes stretching toward a distant city
Seeds blown from a farmer's open hand across a field

sections.meaning: Shem, the older brother of Japheth, became the father of all the sons of Eber, and his family grew branch by branch.
ideas: A very long outdoor table under trees at dusk with a family of three generations sharing a meal
Seen from above, dozens of people of all ages gathered on a lawn around an old man, looking up
An old man in a garden chair with children and grandchildren close around him
A family tree pinned on a wall of photographs
A row of boots from big to small at a door
A farmhouse kitchen full of cousins
A grandfather teaching a grandchild to plant a tree
Hands of many ages around one bowl
Many candles lit from one old lamp
A crowded porch of family at sunset

sections.meaning: In Peleg's days the earth was divided; Joktan's many sons settled from Mesha to Sephar, in the hill country of the east.
ideas: Aerial view of a green plain split in two by a river dividing around an island, fields on each side
A great valley seen from above with a river cutting a plateau into two halves, one lit and one in cloud shadow
Sunrise behind a long range of bare golden hills in the east, a dusty track winding in, no people
A flock of sheep on a rocky ridge at sunrise facing east
A single crack running across dry ground
Two halves of a broken plate on a table
A bridge across a divided gorge
Two mountains with a valley of mist between
A wide river delta at dawn
A long road leading east into the hills

sections.meaning: From these three families the nations spread over the earth after the flood.
ideas: Aerial night view over a dark land with many separate glowing clusters of towns and cities scattered far apart
Early morning from a mountain pass over many far-apart small villages in valleys to the horizon, thin smoke rising from each
Ripples spreading out across a still lake
Seeds scattering from a ripe seed head across a hillside
A flock of starlings spreading across a dusk sky
Many roads leaving one crossroads across a plain
Lights of a coastline at night
A handful of grain scattered over a ploughed field
A river fanning into many streams across a plain
A sunrise touching many separate rooftops

scenes.principle: And these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.
scenes.shows: Three young men, brothers, seen from behind, walk side by side on a wet shining road across a fresh green plain at sunrise.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, three young men, brothers, ordinary people of today in plain clothes, walk shoulder to shoulder along a wet shining road across a wide fresh green plain at sunrise, the washed-clean land stretching before them. The three men and the horizon are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: The sons of Japheth were Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.
scenes.shows: Aerial view of an archipelago, every island with its own small harbor town and bay, turquoise water between.
scenes.prompt: Aerial view of an archipelago of many separate islands in turquoise water, each island with its own small white harbor town and curved sandy bay, small boats on the water between them. The islands fill the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the sons of Ham were Cush and Egypt and Put and Canaan.
scenes.shows: A broad slow river through desert at dawn, palm groves and reeds on its banks, golden dunes beyond, one white-sailed boat.
scenes.prompt: At dawn a broad slow river winds through a pale golden desert, thick green palm groves and reed beds along its banks and golden dunes beyond, a single white-sailed boat on the water. The river and the dunes are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Cush fathered Nimrod. He began to be a mighty man on the earth.
scenes.shows: A powerful hunter silhouetted on a boulder against a huge open sky, bow in hand, a wide plain far below.
scenes.prompt: A powerful hunter in plain outdoor clothes stands tall on a great boulder, bow in hand, dark against an enormous glowing open sky, a wide plain far below with a far herd of deer. The hunter and sky are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon and Erech and Accad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
scenes.shows: Aerial view at dusk of a great city sprawling across a wide plain beside a broad river, lit streets and bridges to the horizon.
scenes.prompt: Aerial view at dusk of a great city sprawling across a wide flat plain beside a broad river, its streets and bridges glowing with lights, the city stretching to the horizon under a deep orange sky. The city is in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And Egypt fathered the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim
scenes.shows: A row of differently painted front doors down a narrow hill street, a different family on each doorstep.
scenes.prompt: A narrow sunlit hill street with a row of houses each with a differently painted front door, and a different family sitting or standing on each doorstep, the street climbing toward the top of the frame. The houses and families are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: and the Arvadites and the Zemarites and the Hamathites. And afterward the families of the Canaanites were scattered.
scenes.shows: A dandelion gone to seed on a green hill above the sea, its seeds streaming off in the wind over an old low stone wall.
scenes.prompt: A dandelion gone to seed on a green hillside above a far blue sea, its white seeds streaming off in the wind across an old low drystone wall. The dandelion, seeds and wall are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And to Shem also, the father of all the sons of Eber, the brother of Japheth the eldest, sons were born.
scenes.shows: A very long outdoor table under trees at dusk with string lights, a family of three generations sharing a meal.
scenes.prompt: A very long outdoor table under big trees at dusk with warm string lights, one large family of three generations, grandparents, parents and many children, sharing a meal and laughing together, seen from the end of the table. The family and table are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And to Eber two sons were born. The name of the one was Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother's name was Joktan.
scenes.shows: Aerial view of a green plain split in two by a river that divides around an island, fields on each side, morning mist.
scenes.prompt: Aerial view of a wide green plain of patchwork fields split in two by a broad river that divides around a long island into separate channels, morning mist in the hollows. The river and plain are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: And the place where they lived was from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the hill country of the east.
scenes.shows: The sun rising behind a long range of bare golden hills in the east, a dusty track winding into them.
scenes.prompt: The sun rises behind a long range of bare golden hill country far to the east, soft light across dry slopes and a dusty track winding into the hills. No people are visible. The hills and sun are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.

scenes.principle: These are the families of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations. And from these the nations separated on the earth after the flood.
scenes.shows: Aerial night view over a dark land with many separate glowing clusters of towns and cities scattered far apart.
scenes.prompt: Aerial night view over a wide dark land, many separate glowing clusters of towns and cities scattered far apart across it and along a coast, the horizon curving under a starry sky. The lights and horizon are in the upper part of the frame.  The important part is in the upper half of the picture; the lower part is plain foreground.
